title: Zephyr: unprotect_request (decrypt)
notes: Implemented strict Zephyr OSCORE request unprotection: reject reserved option bits and non-canonical/exhausted PIVs; require exact recipient KID and KID Context binding; retain full-width replay reservation through authenticated decrypt and semantic/output validation; rollback on every failure; commit before exposing outputs; defer CoAP correlation output until success. Added focused regressions for output-capacity retry, spoofed/missing KID/context, reserved bits, malformed/noncanonical/exhausted PIV, authentication failure, replay, invalid request code/options/empty payload marker, and exact retry after rollback. Preserved concurrent response, uint64 PIV, active-slot, and NVM hunks. Gates: isolated qemu_x86 OSCORE request-focused suite 6/6 PASS; Zephyr compile/link PASS; Python OSCORE cross-parity 12 PASS; Rust cross-parity 4 PASS/1 ignored helper; cargo test -p lichen-oscore --no-default-features PASS; relevant cppcheck PASS; git diff --check PASS. Broad Zephyr image retains unrelated pre-existing stale NVM/peer expectations and a malformed legacy RFC vector, outside this bead.
close_reason: Implemented and verified strict request decrypt/authentication, binding, full-width replay rollback/commit, fail-before-output, and malformed-boundary behavior.
